mechanism: Both fluconazole and propylthiouracil can cause hepatotoxicity and agranulocytosis, with fluconazole potentially inhibiting metabolism of PTU through CYP450 enzymes, increasing PTU exposure and adverse effects.
action: Monitor liver function tests, complete blood count, and thyroid function regularly; consider alternative antifungal if possible; educate patient on signs of hepatotoxicity and agranulocytosis.
